title: EmDash Tracy Business: an unticked page stays off in every edition and language, out of every menu
steps: S1: Run node --test --test-reporter=tap tests/personalize-pages.test.mjs from packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-business.
S2: The tests run the template's personalize tool on its EmDash mock with News unticked, on a site written in Vietnamese and on one with no language chosen.
expect: S1: every named test reports ok.
S2: the unticked page is unpublished in every edition served, no menu leads to it, the home page is never hidden.
evidence: On a root written in Vietnamese the labels lane translated the unticked page and the write door published it again: Tracy Business EmDash 1.7.2 on dev answered /projects 200 with Projects unticked (commit 4e589f239, #1013).
fence: The personalize tool's hide rule applied to every edition and menu, whatever the language.

tests: News unticked: its page is off the site in every language written, its menu items are gone, and --revert brings both back
the home page is never hidden, even when its id comes unticked
a site written in Vietnamese: the unticked page stays unpublished and out of the menu, though its labels are translated
no language chosen: the unticked page is off every edition still served, and no menu leads to it
